query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, and he was so excited to chase a squirrel up the oak tree at the end of the street, he almost pulled the leash right out of my hand. On the way home I stopped at the little bakery around the corner and picked up a fresh blueberry scone, it's still warm and smells absolutely amazing. I was also thinking about what movie I should watch tonight after I finish my laundry, I've been meaning to check out that new comedy that everyone's been talking about lately. Oh right, I need to cancel my pending order #W9348897, the reason is that I no longer need the items in it.
